# New change requests are created as drafts by default,
# without any spice.submit.draft configuration.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2025-07-05T21:28:29Z'

# setup
cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'

# set up a fake GitHub remote
shamhub init
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main

env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

# Test case 1: non-interactive submit without any flags or config
# should create a draft CR by default.
git add feature1.txt
gs bc -m 'Add feature1' feature1
gs branch submit --fill
stderr 'Created #'

shamhub dump change 1
cmpenvJSON stdout $WORK/golden/draft-default.json

# Test case 2: --no-draft overrides the default and creates a non-draft CR.
git add feature2.txt
gs bc -m 'Add feature2' feature2
gs branch submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #'

shamhub dump change 2
cmpenvJSON stdout $WORK/golden/draft-override.json

-- repo/feature1.txt --
Contents of feature1

-- repo/feature2.txt --
Contents of feature2

-- golden/draft-default.json --
{

  "state": "open",
  "title": "Add feature1",
  "draft": true,
  "body": "",

  "head": {
    "repository": {
      "owner": "alice",
      "name": "example"
    },
    "ref": "feature1",
    "sha": "dbcf2133e568c7abf343166d32aefb2ecd3ec8be"
  },

      "owner": "alice",
      "name": "example"
    },

    "sha": "3bcbc80b165d8b4bb7fe792b7ca9effc713b32a5"
  }
}

    },
